programs.title: Closer
programs.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programs.title: The Idea of You
programs.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programs.title: Big Fish
programs.desc: Edward Bloom (Albert Finney), a brilliant storyteller and favorite of the neighborhood, is dying.His son Will (Billy Crudup) left home long ago, not wanting to live forever in the shadow of his father's fantastic stories.Now she returns to accompany him in his last moments.Listening to Edward's stories again, Will tries to put them together to make sense.The picture that emerges is surprisingly coherent and shows the father's life in a new light.The son realizes who his father really was.Tim Burton, one of the most eccentric creators of American cinema, created a film that captivates with its warmth, fairy-tale atmosphere and surreal poetics.The script is based on the novel "Big Fish: A Story of Mythic Proportions" by Daniel Wallace.We will see Ewan McGregor as young Edward.The atmospheric music received an Oscar nomination.

programs.title: Eine Million Minuten
programs.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programs.title: Greta Gerwig: Itinerary Of A Rising Star
programs.desc: A profile of the actress, screenwriter and director who became famous for her bold role in the comedy-drama "Frances Ha", as well as as co-author of the brilliant adaptation of "Little Women" and the record-breaking film "Barbie".Thanks to these productions, in less than a decade, Greta Gerwig became both an icon of independent cinema and a hit filmmaker.In 2024, she also served as president of the jury at the Cannes Film Festival.What additionally distinguishes her are her feminist beliefs.The artist's interests have always been focused on women and the fight against stereotypes.

programs.title: A Carpenter Christmas Romance
programs.desc: Writer Andrea returns to her family farm in Wildwood just before the holidays.She begins an affair with her ex-boyfriend Seth, who was employed in the crew renovating the town after the recent fire.

programs.title: And Just Like That...
programs.desc: HBO 2 offers a diverse selection of high-quality films and family-friendly programming, serving as the perfect companion channel for around-the-clock movies.

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
programs.desc: A new school year begins at Hogwarts, the famous wizarding school.Harry Potter and his friend Ron Weasley have been unlucky from the beginning.They miss their train, so they take a flying car to get there.Unfortunately, they cause a crash, which angers Prof.Snape.It turns out that last year's feat, neutralizing Lord Voldemort, made Harry a hero.The young wizard is not happy about his sudden popularity.It does not help him concentrate on his studies and even makes enemies, including among teachers.Meanwhile, prof.Dumbledore warns that evil lurks within the walls of the academy.An ominous writing appears on the wall, declaring that the Chamber of Secrets has been opened.Students and teachers are in danger.Potter must find out what got out of the chamber and defeat the dark forces that have taken over Hogwarts.He is helped by his friends, Ron and Hermione.

programs.title: Dragons: Gift of the Night Fury
programs.desc: The Vikings prepare for the winter festival of Snoggletog.Suddenly, all the dragons in the village fly away for an unknown reason.Only Toothless remains, and he needs Hiccup to fly into the air.Hiccup wants to give his ward a gift for the holiday.He prepares a prosthetic tail for him so that Toothless can fly on his own.The gifted dragon disappears, just like other reptiles.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Julia Kamińska and Jacek Król.

programs.title: The Karate Kid
programs.desc: Teenage Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), from New Jersey to Los Angeles.He becomes friends with his peer Tommy (Rob Garrison).During a beach party, the boy meets a nice blonde, Ali (Elisabeth Shue).The two immediately take a liking to each other, which does not please her ex-boyfriend, Johnny (William Zabka).As an excellent karateka, he easily teaches his rival a lesson.Humiliated, Daniel also decides to start training eastern martial arts to defeat the enemy.Unfortunately, he cannot join the local club because Johnny and his equally unpleasant and brutal friends practice there.One evening, Daniel is attacked by them again.He is saved from trouble by an old man, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), who turns out to be a master of eastern martial arts.From then on, the teenager learns the secrets of karate under his watchful eye.The Japanese teaches him not only the fighting style, but also a lot about life... A perfect film for karate lovers.For his role as Master Noriyuki "Pat" Morita, he received an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Golden Globe nomination.Director of photography John G. Avildsen is known as the creator of the legendary "Rocky" from 1976 with Sylvester Stallone.

programs.title: The Emoji Movie
programs.desc: Millions of smartphones around the world have an application for sending messages through which you can communicate your feelings and moods.This is where the city of Textopolis, where emotes live, is hidden.The task of each of them is to express a different state of mind.The exception is Minek, who can express every emotion.However, he dreams of being like others.Together with Piątek and the superhacker Matrix, they set off on a journey through the phone in search of a solution.The animated film is directed by Tony Leondis ("Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters").The Polish language version featured, among others: Paweł Ciołkosz, Szymon Roszak, Monika Pikuła and Katarzyna Kwiatkowska.

programs.title: Creator
programs.desc: Future.There is a war going on between humans and artificial intelligence.Joshua, a former secret service agent, suffers after the disappearance of his pregnant wife Maya.He undertakes the task of tracking down and eliminating the elusive Creator - an architect of advanced technology whose invention may end the conflict or destroy humanity.The Creator's new work, called AlphaO, threatens an American battle station used to fight AI.Joshua and a team of elite agents go behind enemy lines.He hopes that during the mission he will be able to find his beloved, because he received information that the woman may be there.While traversing the darkness of the occupied area, he discovers that the new weapon he is to eliminate is artificial intelligence hidden in the body of a child.
